emails.subject: Great connecting at [Event Name] — let's build on the conversation
emails.body:

I wanted to follow up with a few ways that partnering with Hitachi Vantara can help you create new opportunities and deliver more value to customers:

• Get support to win. Take advantage of partner training, enablement, demo resources, and opportunities for joint planning and go-to-market collaboration.

• Activate marketing faster. The Partner Marketing Hub gives you ready-to-use campaigns and assets to help generate demand and engage customers: https://partnermarketing.hitachivantara.com/

I'd love to continue our conversation and identify one or two opportunities we could pursue together. Would you be available for a brief follow-up next week?
